title: mail timestamp conversion functions are undocumented and lack independent test vectors
description: mail/email/types.rs: days_to_year_doy, doy_to_month_day, is_leap implement a complete UTC datetime conversion but have no doc comments and are tested only for RFC 3339 formatting, not for numerical accuracy. Add cross-validation against chrono or time crate for known dates (e.g., 1970-01-01, 2000-03-01 leap day, 2038-01-19).
